# Rucio EIC MCP server

An MCP server that exposes Rucio data discovery for the ePIC production datasets.

## Installation

```bash
uvx git+https://github.com/eic/rucio-eic-mcp-server
```

## Tools

- `list_datasets(campaign)`: list datasets of one simulation campaign.
- `list_files(did)`: list the files of a dataset.
